definitions: To risk everything on a single venture or opportunity.
To concentrate all of one's resources or efforts into one area, thereby increasing vulnerability to failure.
examples: Don't put all your eggs in one basket with that investment.
She decided not to put all her eggs in one basket and applied to several universities.
It's unwise to put all your eggs in one basket when starting a business.
lemma: put all your eggs in one basket
source: put all your eggs in one basket
